query: 水风险评估 水风险评估 衡量企业识别、评估和管理水风险的体系成熟度。 内容质量得分 (取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：使用了专业风险识别工具（如 WRI Aqueduct），具备水压力情景分析，有针对高风险站点的应对措施，且建立了水资源治理机制（如首席水官或专项考核）。 • 1分（合格）：有基础的水风险识别和定性描述，具备通用性应对措施（如节水计划），但缺乏针对性工具应用或深度的情景评估。 • 0分（不合格）：无水风险评估披露，或仅笼统提及“重视水资源保护”。 水风险评估 水压力 基准水压力 水资源短缺 干旱风险 洪涝风险 流域风险 高水压力地区 高风险站点 水压力情景分析 WRI Aqueduct WWF水风险过滤器 water risk assessment water stress baseline water stress water scarcity drought risk flood risk basin risk high water stress areas high-risk sites water stress scenario WRI Aqueduct WWF Water Risk Filter 企业是否使用专业水风险工具（如WRI Aqueduct）识别水风险？ 是否按流域、运营点或高水压力区域开展评估？ 是否包含水压力情景分析？ 对高风险站点采取了哪些针对性应对措施？ 是否建立水资源治理机制（如专项职责或考核）？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '水风险评估'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否使用专业水风险工具（如WRI Aqueduct）识别水风险？ 是否按流域、运营点或高水压力区域开展评估？ 是否包含水压力情景分析？ 对高风险站点采取了哪些针对性应对措施？ 是否建立水资源治理机制（如专项职责或考核）？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“重视节水”；仅有用水效益目标而无风险评估；仅有排污合规数据；仅有社区饮水公益项目；区分：水风险评估关注风险识别工具、情景与高风险站点应对；用水效益目标与行动方案关注节水量化目标及工程/管理措施，二者不可互相替代。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: Water consumption of the Group is sourced from municipal water supply. During the Reporting Period, the Group did not have any issues in sourcing water. results.text: Wastewater discharge management is also an important way to preserve water resources. Environmental Protection

[Content]
Wastewater discharge management is also an important way to preserve water resources. As our cargo terminals are located in coastal areas, the Group pays extra attention to wastewater discharge. Wastewater treatment facilities were built with careful planning to divert all wastewater within the boundary of cargo terminals to the treatment facilities for proper treatment before discharge. Apart from this, the wastewater is collected at the terminal to prevent wastewater discharge and pollution in the nearby coastal region.

results.section: Environmental Protection / 7.1.4. Effective Utilisation of Materials and Waste Reduction
results.text: The operation of cargo terminals is vulnerable to severe weather events as they are located close to the coastal areas. The Group pays attention to its terminal operators and cargo safety under unexpected extreme weather caused by climate change. To enhance the preparedness in responding to severe weather events, all subsidiaries under the terminal navigation logistics business of the Group conduct emergency plans for severe weather conditions. Extreme weather such as typhoons and flooding may cause serious impacts to the environment and the Group's business operation. The Group has identified several environmental emergencies that exhibit a high likelihood and has correspondingly formulated the Environmental Emergency Response Plan to outline our strategies and procedures for responding to environmental emergencies. The plan outlines the functions and responsibilities of relevant departments in the event of environmental emergencies. Regular drills are conducted to test the adequacy and effectiveness of the plan.

results.section: Quality and Reliable Service / Valuing Customer Privacy and Persistence in Information Accuracy
results.text: Every year, we evaluate the performance of our existing suppliers according to the criteria and procedures specified in the Regulations Governing Integrated Supplier Evaluation to ensure suppliers are aligned with our requirements. If the suppliers fail to fulfill our specifications, they will be compelled to develop rectification plans and carry out corrective actions. To facilitate energy-saving, the Group is tended to choose energy-efficient products with Grade 1 Energy Label when procuring air-conditioners and dehumidifiers.
